verdict.rationale: Graphite ships its own scriptable `gt` CLI, installable via npm or Homebrew, with non-mutating options such as `--dry-run`. GT MCP lets AI agents create stacked PRs programmatically, and AI reviews run automatically on every new PR without manual action. However, nothing documents running the CLI headlessly in a CI pipeline, and `gt config` is described as an interactive menu. missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage guide, non-interactive auth (token/env-var) for CI runners, explicit non-interactive flags for all commands, hands-on or independent corroboration of CI automation.
